native_authored_context.name: TSCultPottery85
native_authored_context.txtfile: This book includes`instructions on how to make`charms.`To make the charms`contained within this book`one will first need to make`the unfired charm.  This`can be done on a pottery`wheel with an stalwart charm`pattern, a small block of`magic clay, and some water`to work with.  Additionally`you can do this in batches`of two or three at a time.`Simply double and triple`the amount of materials,`respectively.`Once you have this unfired`charm, you will need to`collect certain materials`according to the race that`you intend the charm to`work for.  You will need a`symbol for the type of`charm you are making:`physical, mental,`spiritual, or derived. `Then you will of course`need one unfired charm. `Then you have a choice.  If`the race uses metal armor,`then you will need spongy`loam.  If the race uses`leather armor then you can`replace the loam with`immaculate marrow.  And if`the race uses cloth armor`you can replace the loam or`marrow with immaculate`spinneret fluid.  Finally`you will need some steely`ore appropriate to the race`you are making the charm`for and some cosgrove powder`to empower it.  Fire this`in a kiln, carefully`arranging the parts over`the charm so that they gain`the essence of the race for`which you are making the`charm.^

It will additionally need water blessed by the deity you wish to attune it to, and befouled spinneret fluid or befouled marrow as a sacrifice to that deity.``You will need to include planar energy shard to empower this symbol.^
